Companion Animal Travel Desk Booking and Arrival Basics

This page covers the booking and arrival handoff steps for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways, and it matters because clean timing and accurate records keep each companion animal moving without delay. New staff should work from the traveler record, confirm the animal details, and keep communication clear, calm, and respectful from the first contact through handoff. The desk supports passengers who travel with pets, and your work helps the cabin team receive the right information before departure and during flight.

For booking, complete the request 84 hours before departure. Check that the passenger name, animal details, and travel route match the file before you move on. If any field is missing, stop the process and obtain the correction before acceptance. Use plain language with the traveler and avoid extra steps that do not serve the record. Keep the interaction brief, polite, and exact.

For arrival pickup, use FM-394 before release. Confirm the pickup name against the file, then verify that the arrival location and contact point are the same ones listed for the trip. If the record shows a mismatch, hold the handoff and direct the case to the senior coordinator without delay. The goal is a smooth transfer from flight care to ground pickup, with no confusion at the end of the journey.

Work every case in the same order: review, verify, record, and pass along. Do not promise what you have not checked. If the passenger asks for an update, give a direct answer based on the record and refer any exception to the proper channel. The Companion Animal Travel Desk depends on fast, accurate handling, and the cabin team relies on your notes to support animal welfare in transit.

Remember to keep the file current, the language respectful, and the transfer exact.
